summary: expirable.LRU invokes onEvict while holding its mutex, so a callback that re-enters the cache deadlocks (explicit removals and background expiry).
test_command_note: The upstream TestLoadingExpired sleeps 100ms for a 5ms-TTL reaper and fails roughly once in 20-30 runs under load (observed on windows/amd64, Go 1.27, at both the base and the fix revision). One retry absorbs that flake. The held-out tests are deterministic: every re-entrancy check runs the operation on a separate goroutine with a 3s deadline, so a deadlocking implementation fails both attempts.

provenance.note: Evaluator-only. base_sha is the parent of the upstream fix; the fix is never reachable from the sealed clone.
provenance.reference_patch: git diff --binary d76085c..9c13c57 (source fix plus upstream tests, unchanged)
provenance.difficulty_note: Six code paths (Add eviction, Remove, RemoveOldest, Purge, Resize, background deleteExpired) must collect evictions under the lock and fire callbacks after unlocking, while keeping callbacks synchronous for explicit operations.
provenance.size_note: about 1.6k non-test Go lines at base

reference.note: Evaluator-only. The verifier renders the reference patch from upstream: git diff --binary -M base_sha commit -- paths, per step.
